h: Shabbos Delight Flows From Eden Through River to Garden

p: delight himself at these three times," etc.
We have already said that the meaning is
that a Jew eats the three meals,
אָז מַלְיָא רֵישֵׁיהּ דִּזְעֵיר אַנְפִּין וְכוּלֵּי
then "the head of Ze'eir Anpin is filled," etc.;
for people do not eat at a single hour,
(And this has been explained several times.)
And the three meals of Shabbos
are in the secret of oneg (delight),
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּרֵאשִׁית כו, סוֹף ע״א)
as written (holy Zohar, Bereishis 26, end of side a);
"And this river that flows and goes forth
is called the World to Come,
which comes constantly and does not cease," etc.;
that is, it will no longer be interrupted;
not as it was at Matan Torah,
when afterward the light was concealed
and the evil inclination returned to its place;
which is a semblance of the World to Come,
while the World to Come is called
and comes constantly and does not cease."
and this is termed in the Idra (288, end of side b)
"the brain of the holy Atika," etc.;
which receives from the dew of Atika,
which is entirely hidden from all conception.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֻקַּת קפב, ב)
and as written in the holy Zohar (Chukas 182b):
is called a garden relative to the Eden above,
and this garden is called Eden
"And the river goes out of Eden
that is, "the head of Ze'eir Anpin is filled
and he casts it to the Field of Apples."
And this is what is written (290b):
which comes constantly and does not cease," etc.;
that there will be no interruption.
'And a river goes out of Eden,'" etc.;
and this follows what is written,
why are vav-dalet included in the yud?
Rather, the planting of the garden
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא נָשֹׂא קכג, רֵישׁ ע״ב)
as written (Ra'aya Mehemna, Naso 123, beginning of side b);
"the Tree of Life is none other than Torah,"
and "HaKadosh Baruch Hu is called Torah"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּשַׁלַּח ס, א)
(as written in the holy Zohar, Beshalach 60a).
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חוּקַּת קפ, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (Chukas 180b):
"the head of Ze'eir Anpin is filled";
the vav is the Tree of Life;
are the other trees of Gan Eden,
and as written in the Gemara (Taanis 29b):
רֵיחַ שָׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בֵּרְכוֹ ה׳ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כז, כז)
"'The fragrance of a field that Hashem has blessed' (Bereishis 27:27)
וּבַמִּדְרָשׁ (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה תּוֹלְדוֹת סוֹף פָּרָשָׁה סה)
and in the Midrash (Midrash Rabbah, Toldos, end of parshah 65):
And this is what it says:
which is the whole of Gan Eden,
from which all the souls blossom forth,
"the bond of life with Hashem your God" (Shmuel I 25:29),
